Common Signs Your Charging Port Needs to Be Replaced
Sometimes it’s hard to tell if the issue lies with your charger, your battery, or the port itself. Here are the most common indicators that your charging port is damaged:

Loose Connection: The charging cable easily falls out or feels loose when plugged into the phone.

Intermittent Charging: Your phone constantly switches between charging and not charging with the slightest movement.

No Power at All: The phone completely fails to recognize the charger, even when using a brand-new cable and wall adapter.

Visible Damage: Bent, broken, or corroded pins inside the USB-C, Lightning, or Micro-USB port.

Slow Charging: Your device takes an unusually long time to charge, or the battery percentage drops even while plugged in.
